quick.gap_to_merge: CI on a pull request leaves out the nightly-only group's files, which only the nightly schedule runs, and the weekly-only group's, which only the Sunday schedule runs; merge-only JOBS (the macOS leg) differ otherwise

app.gap_to_merge: none: app-verify and both app CI jobs run this group after app-build in the app environment

nightly-only.gap_to_merge: Pull requests and main pushes omit these files; the nightly schedule and full manual runs retain every original app-builder witness. app_builders names the only files that may compile an app.

weekly-only.gap_to_merge: Pull requests, main pushes, the nightly schedule and manual runs omit this file; only the Sunday schedule runs the CIF import matrix, about two hours serial.

browser.gap_to_merge: none: browser cases run on every PR in app-wasm after wasm-toolchain; both local verification cadences run group-browser with the same declared prerequisite.

cadence.ruling: owner 2026-08-28 (development hub knowledge/decision-records.md, ): nothing per commit; the quick/CI-PR group before handing to review; the full suite ONCE when ready to merge, after the accept; CI is a two-platform double-check, not a different cadence
cadence.before-review: quick (pixi run verify-quick; what CI runs on a pull request)
cadence.ready-to-merge: full, once (pixi run verify-full == pixi run verify; the mount verify and the x-ship gate; what CI runs on merge)

note: : quick and full name WHEN verification runs; app names the Qt environment required by integration/app, not another cadence. Core tasks retain their prior selections outside integration/app; app-verify and both app CI jobs execute group-app after app-build. Both verify cadences retain all app cases, and each platform's combined full core/app jobs cover the complete collection. Default pytest collection retains every tier for the runtime inventory. Groups name paths, never predicates over runtime; edi declares no fitting corpus. The per-tier audit refuses marker-based deselection. Large single-crystal tutorial relation-graph observations in tests/system/py/test_tutorial_large_population_stages.py retain quick/full system cadence; complete CLI, recipe and native Create/save journeys have explicit nightly-only paths. Whole tutorial exclusion filesystem and checker workflows retain quick/full integration cadence in tests/integration/py/test_tutorial_exclusion_workflows.py. Actual runtime publication configure/permission workflows retain system tier in tests/system/py/test_runtime_publication_reuse.py and their original PR core-job cadence through tools/ci/core-tests.sh. End-to-end phase scan/single-fit parity and reopen workflows live in tests/system/py/test_phase_scan_parity.py and remain explicitly selected in the PR core job by tools/ci/core-tests.sh. Survey event dates on authored and generated assets share one browser worker in group-browser, whose wasm-toolchain prerequisite supplies Playwright and Chrome; core and system shards delegate these exact paths to the app-wasm job. The real public snapshot/workflow mutation journey in tests/system/py/test_public_content_workflows.py retains PR core cadence via core-tests.sh; its former integration measurement exceeded the 1 s tier bound. NCAF and ferrite field navigation keep the same system cadence in their dedicated lesson modules; each module shares one real Home entry and declared project, while every row still drives and asserts its own original Qt input.

local_gap_to_merge.statement: no gap: the review-time quick run (pixi run verify-quick) runs every ruled tier that the merge-time full run and CI-on-merge run; the surfaces differ only in platform (CI adds the macOS runner; CI leaves out the nightly-only group except on the nightly schedule, and the weekly-only group except on the Sunday schedule), not in tiers
